svg.title: Abe-spresso — logo-design-board
svg.desc: A complete logo proposal showing the A-monogram espresso cup, wordmark, reversed lockup, icons, palette and website masthead mockup.

g.aria-label: A PERSONAL SIGNATURE. A DAILY RITUAL.
Abe + espresso. A little cup with a point of view.
A transparent A creates a personal
Two rising strokes suggest fresh coffee;
the brief is a daily reading ritual.
A compact wordmark and a clear baseline
belong to a publication, not a gadget.
LOGO CONCEPT / NOT YET APPLIED TO THE WEBSITE
